title: Coalitional influence
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ and let $J$ be a set of coordinates. The coalitional influence of $J$ is the probability, for a uniformly random input $x$, that the coordinates in $J$ can be assigned values so that $f$ can attain either output $1$ or output $-1$ while all coordinates outside $J$ remain as in $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates
